tasks.title: Move the PDF toolkit into one lazy lib/pdf module with a cached, classifying loader
tasks.dod: loadPdfKit() imports lib/pdf/invoice-pdf-kit once per visit and classifies a failed import as offline or new-version; unit tests for the cache and both classifications pass.

tasks.title: Route every PDF trigger through usePdfAction and warm the toolkit in the editor when idle
tasks.dod: Every PDF trigger calls usePdfAction, which shows preparing / try again / reload states and reports generation failures to Sentry with pdf.stage; no file outside lib/pdf statically imports the toolkit (lint no-restricted-imports); component tests cover each state.

tasks.title: Add the build-output PDF chunk check to CI and e2e tests for first PDF, offline and new-version
tasks.dod: scripts/check-pdf-chunks.ts fails the CI build when a non-editor route's initial chunks contain @react-pdf/renderer and passes on this branch; the PDF e2e (no fetch on open, reuse, 20-run p95 ≤ 3 s at 10 Mbit/s, offline, missing chunk) passes.

tasks.title: Remove the unused UI components and their packages, drop uuid, and keep one theme switcher
tasks.dod: components/ui holds no unused component, package.json drops the packages only they used plus uuid and @types/uuid, one components/theme-toggle.tsx serves the landing page and the app, and build, lint and every test pass.

tasks.title: Mount the editor's confirmation dialog in the invoice-editor modal container
tasks.dod: The editor's ConfirmationModal is rendered only by InvoiceEditorModalContainer, the F-47 onClose behaviour is kept, and the existing confirmation-modal component tests pass.

tasks.title: Rewrite the README setup and test steps and verify them in a fresh clone
tasks.dod: Following README.md word for word in a fresh clone against an empty PostgreSQL database completes every command, every linked file exists, and no secret or shared database address appears.

tasks.title: Create the lib/format module for money, calendar days and moments with a fixed en-US locale
tasks.dod: formatMoney, formatDay and formatMoment are pure, use en-US regardless of the runtime locale and zone, and unit tests pin $1,234.50, UAH 1,234.50, the stored UTC day and a moment in UTC−10/UTC+14.

tasks.title: Route every displayed date and amount through lib/format and forbid ad-hoc formatting by lint
tasks.dod: Every list, dashboard, related-invoices, custom-price and editor display of a date or amount uses lib/format, lint rejects toFixed( and toLocale*String( in components/ and app/, and component tests show the stored day and $1,234.50 under a foreign TZ and locale.

tasks.title: Build the pure invoice document model with its wording in lib/invoice-document
tasks.dod: buildInvoiceDocument(source) returns every label, party, line, formatted date and amount for a draft form and for an issued invoice's issued details, and unit tests over the fixture set (draft, issued, USD, UAH, discount, tax, multiple lines) pass.

tasks.title: Lay out the HTML preview and the PDF from the document model and add the parity test
tasks.dod: The HTML preview and the react-pdf document render only InvoiceDocument fields, a draft with unsaved changes prints its last save, and the parity test shows 100 % identical text between preview and PDF over the fixture set.

tasks.title: Turn the editor store into a per-mount factory provided by context and built from server data
tasks.dod: Each editor mount gets its own store created synchronously from the RSC data and keyed by Freelancer and invoice, the initialize-in-effect and reset-on-unmount are gone, a lint rule forbids the old module-level store, and the existing invoice-integrity and editor component tests plus a new first-render test pass.

tasks.title: Compute a new invoice's today and due date on the server and reserve the invoice-number field
tasks.dod: The new-invoice page passes today in the Freelancer time zone (UTC until saved) and the payment-terms due date as initial data, the browser clock is never consulted, and the number field shows a size-reserved loading state; component tests pin both.

tasks.title: Add the store save command with a form revision and resolve every save outcome in it
tasks.dod: save(intent) reads the form when called, tags it with the form revision and resolves saved, saved-with-edits (totals recomputed from the lines on screen), issued-with-edits (dismissable notice), field errors and changed-elsewhere/totals-changed state; the 50-run race test shows 0 lost edits and totals always equal to the visible lines.

tasks.title: Route Retry, the created-address change and the save dialogs through the save command
tasks.dod: Retry calls save(lastFailedIntent) with the current form; a created invoice replaces the address with its edit URL from inside the command; changed-elsewhere and totals-changed open SCR-10/SCR-09 from store state for Save and Retry alike; Retry while saving or after a store swap is a no-op; component tests per outcome pass.

tasks.title: Send signed-in pages no-store, reload back/forward-cache restores, and prove AC-07 in Chromium and WebKit
tasks.dod: Signed-in page responses carry Cache-Control: private, no-store, SessionRestoreGuard hides and reloads a persisted pageshow before paint, security-headers.test.ts covers the header, and the AC-07 e2e passes in the chromium and webkit projects.

tasks.title: Give every editor field, line field, icon button and row action an announced name and tie errors to fields
tasks.dod: Every editor field has its visible label as its name, line fields announce «{column}, line {n}» from the current index, icon-only buttons and the hidden Print/Download text have names, row actions name the action and the invoice number, and refused fields carry aria-invalid + aria-describedby; component tests assert the names.

tasks.title: Render the editor's phone and desktop layouts from one DOM tree switched by CSS only
tasks.dod: The editor no longer uses useIsMobile to choose what renders, the server HTML at 390 px shows the phone layout, and an e2e test proves a focused line field with «12.» keeps its text and focus across a breakpoint resize; desktop/phone visual snapshots are recorded.

tasks.title: Add the shared AmountInput with a decimal keypad and use it for line, discount, tax and shipping fields
tasks.dod: AmountInput (inputMode=decimal, '.' the only accepted decimal separator) is used for line price and quantity, discount, tax rate and shipping, is registered in docs/design-system.md, and component tests show «12.5» accepted and «12,5» rejected.

tasks.title: Add the CI e2e job with the server/browser date matrix and the accessibility suite
tasks.dod: A CI e2e job builds the app for production against throwaway PostgreSQL and runs the date matrix (zones UTC−10/UTC/UTC+14, browser in another zone, ±5 min around midnight, 0 hydration errors, stored days everywhere) and the axe suite (0 serious/critical on editor new/existing, invoices list, dashboard); both pass.

tasks.title: Add e2e tests that reach every save outcome by Save and by Retry and compare the results
tasks.dod: For created, updated, issued, changed elsewhere, totals changed and field error, the e2e reaches the outcome once by Save and once by Retry (after a forced failure) and asserts the same address, dialog and unsaved flag.
